newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Chem, BASF plan S.Korea chemical study.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Chem, BASF plan S.Korea chemical study.

text.p: Mitsubishi Chemical Corp said on Thursday that it and BASF AG have agreed to conduct a feasibility study on chemical production in South Korea.
The companies are considering producing the chemicals butanedior and tetrahydrofuran in BASF's South Korean factory with production technology licensed by Mitsubishi Chemical.

BASF would build production lines for the chemicals with an annual capacity of 50,000 tonnes in South Korea by the beginning of 1999, and Mitsubishi Chemical would purchase some of the products to market through its distribution routes, Mitsubishi Chemical said in a statement.
Butanedior is mainly used in electronic appliance parts and tetrahydrofuran for sportswear.
